$comment: Money rates for the Costs page (design/ci/health-dashboard.md section 7), with the date each was checked. A missing rate (null) shows NO DATA, never zero. Fixed monthly lines are spread over the days of the month.

t4.$comment: machine.dev T4: minutes rounded up plus one for boot, times the tenancy's rate. Checked 2026-10-25.

llm.$comment: CI's Gemini spend, as tools/llm-spend.mjs counts it: a job's logged cost when its step 'LLM regression cost: <usd> USD' names one (release.yml from 2026-10-29; bisect.yml llm-lane points and cut-off runs from #5062), else a flat 0.94 USD per paid step (kept: it prices only steps from before their cost was logged, which ran before caching) (measured 2026-10-12 as 194 calls at 0.00485 USD, tmp/ai-cost/report.md; October 2026 averaged 189 calls a release run, 375 for the one bisect point). A paid step is release.yml's LLM regression step, or the test step of a point of a bisect of the llm lane (run name 'Bisect (llm lane)'; legacyBisectRuns lists the one from before the name said so), with a PAID conclusion. Local runs with the same key are not counted. Checked 2026-10-29.

fixedMonthly.$comment: github: Team, 2 seats (checked 2026-10-25). cloudflare: Workers Paid plan (checked 2026-10-25). sentry: plan price not recorded yet.

cloudflareUsage.$comment: Cloudflare past the Workers Paid plan, by measured usage metric (src/collector/usage.ts): included per month and USD per million past it; a stock in bytes is included in GB-months and priced per GB-month. Workers CPU time and D1 storage are not priced. https://developers.cloudflare.com/workers/platform/pricing/ and /r2/pricing/. Checked 2026-11-23 against the Oct 25 to Nov 23 bill (D1 rows read 30.91 USD, rows written 12.00 USD).

awsUsage.$comment: Each AWS usage metric's daily allowance, its share of the 40 USD AWS target (src/collector/usage.ts): DynamoDB on demand at 0.625 USD per million write units and 0.125 per million read units (16 and 4 USD a month), Lambda at 0.20 USD per million invocations plus duration, the HTTP API at 1 USD per million requests. Set 2026-11-23.

actionsListPrice.$comment: List-price value of Actions minutes, never money (free for this public repository). Checked 2026-10-25.
